summary: Golub Capital Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K to report entering into the Fourth Amendment to its existing unsecured revolving credit agreement with lender GC Advisors LLC, as borrower. The amendment extends the maturity date of the facility from its prior term to July 3, 2029. No new borrowing amount, pricing terms, or structural changes are disclosed beyond the maturity extension. The filing is a routine amendment to a revolving credit facility and does not involve any special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review.
